# RadioReach

> Radio promotion resources and radio station contacts for independent
> musicians and artists. RadioReach publishes free, practical guides on
> radio promotion and sells the Radio Reach Vault, a downloadable directory
> of 18,000+ radio station contacts organized by station, location, and role.

## Product

- [Radio Reach Vault](https://radioreach.us/): 18,000+ radio station contacts
  for independent artists — college, community, commercial, and online radio,
  organized by station, location, role, phone, and email.

## Free guides — start here

- [How to Get Your Song on the Radio](https://radioreach.us/resources/how-to-get-your-song-on-the-radio/): the complete eight-step path from station research to confirmed spins.
- [Radio Stations Accepting Music Submissions](https://radioreach.us/resources/radio-stations-accepting-music/): how to recognize stations open to independent music and pitch them.
- [College Radio Submissions](https://radioreach.us/resources/college-radio-submissions/): finding music directors, timing sends, and charting on college radio.
- [Radio Promotion for Independent Artists](https://radioreach.us/resources/radio-promotion-independent-artists/): the full campaign playbook with an eight-week timeline.

## Templates and press kits

- [Radio Pitch Email Templates](https://radioreach.us/resources/radio-pitch-email-templates/): six outreach templates, subject lines, and a personalization checklist.
- [Electronic Press Kit (EPK) for Radio](https://radioreach.us/resources/electronic-press-kit-radio/): building the EPK and one-sheet radio programmers expect.

## Genre playbooks

- [Hip-Hop Radio Promotion](https://radioreach.us/resources/hip-hop-radio-promotion/): mixshows, college hip-hop directors, DJ pools, and clean edits.
- [Electronic Music Radio Promotion](https://radioreach.us/resources/electronic-music-radio-promotion/): pitching shows, radio edits, remixes, and guest mixes.
- [Country and Americana Radio Promotion](https://radioreach.us/resources/country-radio-promotion/): the Americana, Triple A, and regional radio paths for indie country.

## Strategy and reference

- [DIY Radio Promotion vs. Hiring a Radio Promoter](https://radioreach.us/resources/diy-radio-promotion-vs-radio-promoter/): costs, control, reporting, and red flags compared honestly.
- [Radio Promotion FAQ](https://radioreach.us/resources/radio-promotion-faq/): straight answers on submissions, costs, timelines, royalties, and etiquette.
- [Radio Promotion Glossary](https://radioreach.us/resources/radio-promotion-glossary/): 40+ radio industry terms explained in plain English.
